document_info.requirement_name: Beispielanforderung: ABF manufacturing yield loss analysis

background.summary: Dies ist ein integriertes Beispielgeschaeft fuer den schnellen Start mit einer vorbefuellten Vorlage. ABF yield data is split across MES, QMS, inspection, and equipment systems. Quality and process teams need a unified view to identify yield loss by lot, panel, product, process step, equipment, and defect reason.
background.objective: Aus dem Beispiel sollen PRD und Design-Dokument erzeugt werden; spaetere Nutzeraenderungen haben Vorrang.

Abnormal yield alerts and closure tracking

core_scenarios: Engineer reviews yield trend by product and process step.

Process owner creates an abnormal closure action.
